comments.body_html: Bro, maybe I’m dumb, but how do I clear a weapon malfunction? I checked the whole description and only found “Inspect Weapon,” but nothing about fixing the malfunction.

comments.author: thablackunicorn
comments.body_html:
EFT clears malfunctions through the normal reload/chamber actions (it’s contextual). So on RaidPad:

  • Misfires → tap X (Reload) — racks/clears it.
  • Jams / feed issues → RB + X (check chamber; double-tap = unload magazine).
